sections.content: Mastering Spanish negation means embracing the dual-position rule: if the negative word follows the verb, *no* must precede the verb (*No vi a nadie*); if it precedes the verb, *no* is omitted (*Nadie vino*).

items.spanish: Nadie vino y no ocurrió nada.

items.english: —I don't understand this exercise. —Neither do I.

sections.content: Always remember the positive/negative pairs: alguien/nadie, algo/nada, algún/ningún, también/tampoco, siempre/nunca.
